tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: What Stocks and Vibes is, what it is not (a simulator, never a broker), and its public pages.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What is free, the AI credit packs and the Live Data plans with their USD prices and renewal terms.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Search the options, stock and risk glossary by word or category; returns terms with their definitions.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: One glossary term by slug or name, with its definition, example and page link.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Blog posts newest first, optionally by tag: title, date, summary, tags and link.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: One blog post by slug, with its markdown body (long posts are cut at a fixed length and say so).

tools.name: list_sec_filings
tools.description: SEC EDGAR filings this site has stored for a US-listed symbol, newest first, with links to sec.gov. Read from storage, never fetched per call.

tools.name: list_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider transactions from the Forms 3, 4 and 5 this site has stored for a US-listed symbol, newest filing first. Read from storage, never fetched per call.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
